text: {"differences": [{"side": "en", "quote": "For although no one individual is considered to be head of state in Switzerland, the President of the Swiss Confederation should be accorded the same standing as his or her foreign counterparts when they meet.", "severity": 0.6, "before": "For the host country, however, the situation is somewhat different.\nFor although no one individual is considered to be head of state in Switzerland,"}, {"side": "tgt", "quote": "all’estero il presidente della Confederazione deve tuttavia poter incontrare le più alte cariche da pari a pari.", "severity": 0.6, "before": "Se in Svizzera la funzione di capo di Stato non è ricoperta da nessuna persona singolarmente,"}]}
